svg.text: Plate 994 x 280 mm with 25 mm flanges folded down on all four

svg.text: edges (fold the long edges first, then the short ones).

svg.text: Fit: top face 380 mm above the ground (278.5 above the floor),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front edge 60 mm in front of the centre line, back edge 220 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: behind it, clear of the back panel flanges.

svg.text: Its side flanges are riveted to the side panels, four rivets each.
